closest.text: ## Company: Qualcomm India Private Limited ## Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering General Summary: * 12~16+ Years of Experience in the Linux embedded domain to design, develop and support software solutions on multi-core ARM/CPUs, Strong C/C++ programming skills. * Embedded Platforms experience including low-level drivers and firmware, kernel and user-space components on Automotive Grade Linux and Yocto build system for developing and maintaining the software stack for IVI and ADAS systems. * Design and development of software for heterogeneous compute platforms consisting of ARMs, GPUs, DSPs, and specialized hardware accelerators in an embedded SoC systems with J-TAG or ICE debuggers; * Experience in real-time SW development for embedded products, RT kernel. * Hands on experience in leading medium to large technical teams. * Hands on experience of driver development on any RTOS and Linux userspace on AGL framework. Detailed understanding SoC hardware blocks - Clocks, PLLs, GPIO, Interrupt Controllers (GIC), Peripherals (SPI/I2C/PCIE/CAN/Ethernet/USB/UFS), power management. Experience in Linux kernel architecture, device drivers and memory management. * Experience in ISO26262/functional safety and safe Linux is highly recommended. * Exposure to one or more of below technology areas is a plus * Multiprocessor Architecture, ARM processors, caching, interrupts, etc., * Virtualization technologies across CPU and MM hardware accelerators * Motivated self-starter with excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrated ability to work with engineers/partners/customers across different geographies. * Demonstrated experience working with senior management in a corporate environment. * Demonstrated experience in business process streamlining and transformation that includes disciplined approach to digitized services enabling. * Hands-on technical lead who is not hesitant to dig into the details where needed to get first-hand knowledge of the issues and play an active and personal role in steering team success. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. OR PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. • 6+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. OR PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. • 4+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc. Applicants: Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. closest.title: Senior Test Engineer - AI/ML
closest.text: While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth. If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi! Role: Senior Test Engineer - AI/ML Experience: 3-6 years Location: Mumbai/Bangalore (Hybrid) Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain UI and API automation test suites using modern automation frameworks. Independently own end-to-end testing activities including test planning, automation development, execution, defect management, and reporting. Validate AI/ML applications, Generative AI solutions, LLM-powered applications, and intelligent workflows. Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end test automation for traditional and AI-enabled applications. Develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks, libraries, and utilities. Automate API testing using REST Assured (Java) or Python Requests. Develop UI automation using Playwright. Validate backend data using SQL and perform database verification. Develop automated validations for AI model outputs, prompt responses, RAG pipelines, and chatbot conversations. Validate AI responses for correctness, consistency, relevance, grounding, safety, hallucinations, and bias. Collaborate with ML Engineers, Software Engineers, and Product Owners to define AI quality validation strategies. Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and implement quality gates. Leverage GenAI tools to accelerate test case generation, automation development, debugging, documentation, and productivity. Contribute to AI testing frameworks, accelerators, and Quality Engineering best practices. Mentor junior engineers and promote automation-first and AI-first Quality Engineering practices. Must have skills: Strong understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), SDLC, Agile, and Scrum methodologies. Hands-on experience in designing test strategies, test scenarios, test cases, and test execution. Strong expertise in UI automation using Playwright and API automation using REST Assured (Java) or Python Requests. Hands-on experience with Postman for API testing and validation. Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in database testing and backend data validation. Experience integrating automation suites with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar. Proficiency with Git and version control best practices. Hands-on experience testing AI/ML or Generative AI applications. Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), chatbots, copilots, or AI agents. Experience validating AI responses for accuracy, relevance, consistency, hallucinations, toxicity, bias, and safety. Experience designing test scenarios for prompt engineering and AI workflow validation. Understanding of AI evaluation techniques and automated output validation. Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks or libraries (e.g., DeepEval, Ragas, LangSmith, Promptfoo, MLflow, or similar). Experience using GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Kiro, Claude, or similar to accelerate test design, automation development, debugging, test data generation, and documentation. Strong debugging, root cause analysis, and analytical problem-solving skills. Ability to independently own end-to-end testing activities with minimal supervision. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to mentor junior engineers and promote automation and Quality Engineering best practices. Strong attention to detail with a quality-first and automation-first mindset. Nice to have skills Knowledge of AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, ECS/EKS, and IAM. Experience testing cloud-native applications deployed on AWS. Experience in Data Warehouse, ETL, or Data Pipeline testing. Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6. Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application testing. Relevant certifications in Playwright, AWS, Quality Engineering, or Agile are an added advantage. If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us !

closest.title: Architect Software Engineer
closest.text: Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world! Data Platform Architect: We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Data Platform Architect to work on Qualys’ next-generation data platform and middleware. Working alongside a very talented team of engineers and architects, you will be responsible for prototyping, designing, developing and supporting a highly scalable SaaS based cloud security data platform. This is a great opportunity to be an integral part of a team building Qualys’ next generation microservices based technology platform processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day, leverage open - source technologies, and work on challenging and business-impacting projects. Responsibilities As a platform architect, you will be responsible for the availability and scalability of Qualys’s relational and NoSQL databases, search engines, graph databases, caches , big data systems and message pipelines. This at the s cale of a million transactions per second in NoSQL databases, across trillions of datapoints in the search engine, billions of messages per day flowing through the message pipelines and scaling 100s of terabytes of data in relational databases all with sub - second latencies . Responsible for driving the data source and providing data platform as a service to all applications built in Qualys. You will be part of the architecture review board reviewing application s’ architecture and identifying the data scale needs. Investigate the cutting - edge technologies , do POC, and then be responsible for defining the guidelines for using the data technologies at scale . Be the face and developer advocate of the stack you own and contribute back to open - source community if any enhancement is needed to fit in the Qualys ecosystem. Applying Machine Learning and AI technologies to improve the availability and performance of data platform services while keeping the operational costs down . Conduct brown bag sessions with application development teams to share guidelines, POC findings and industry trends. You will be instrumenting both day 1 and day 2 operations on these data technologies, keeping the 100s of thousands if not millions of operations per second. Migrate or burst into cloud and scale the stack with zero downtime. You will also be responsible for reviewing the cloud-native architecture of data platform technologies. You will be constantly in the hunt for better solutions out there to resolve the current issues with scal e , availability, and costs across cloud platforms. Co-develop with a strong sense of ownership, Qualys’ big-data platform that scales to meet/exceed the demands of processing over 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day. Architecture, performance, scalability, high availability, and security will be your primary goals for delivering a first-rate experience to our customers. Work closely with engineering teams, product management and operations to provide platform and infrastructure features and components to support Qualys’ business objectives . A day in the life… Apply advanced concepts, theories, and principles to create multi-disciplinary innovations and solutions for the most complex or risky data source related situations Contribute to the development of new data platform principles and concepts Collaborate with and suggest best practices to application teams in Qualys Provide thought leadership across multiple teams to ensure that systems and services are designed, and operating to achieve optimal levels of performance, reliability and sustainability interacting with data platform in Qualys Ensure security coding practices and security system fundamentals across multiple teams Demonstrate ability to identify important areas to instrument across multiple teams Who you are... A trendsetter. You thrive in an intellectually challenging environment with leading edge technologies. A teacher. You’re able to mentor your peers and help our team grow. A learner. You have an insatiable thirst for knowledge and greater understanding. A pragmatist. Your goal is to create useful products, not build technology for technology’s sake. An empath. You understand what the customer needs and use that perspective to create the best user experience. How we work... With others. We have remote pairing tools where engineers often work together, as well as virtual collaboration tools for building architecture solutions. With transparency. We encourage open dialog and discourse. We don’t encourage silos. With agility. We don’t believe in following a process for the sake of the process . We ship frequently and focus on delivering incremental value. With open minds . We are committed to building a diverse team of people with unique perspectives. This encourages a healthy and inclusive environment that builds a more sustainable, successful company. With pride. We value our people most of all. We invest in ourselves by applying our own strengths and interests to company needs. Qualifications BS/MS degree in Computer Science o r related field. 1 2 + years of hands-on experience with developing SaaS-based software products and solutions for service-oriented deployments in public (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, etc.) or private clouds. Prior experience as a lead engineer or architect. Prior experience with RDBMS systems and NoSQL databases. closestEng.title: Architect Software Engineer
closestEng.text: Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world! Data Platform Architect: We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Data Platform Architect to work on Qualys’ next-generation data platform and middleware. Working alongside a very talented team of engineers and architects, you will be responsible for prototyping, designing, developing and supporting a highly scalable SaaS based cloud security data platform. This is a great opportunity to be an integral part of a team building Qualys’ next generation microservices based technology platform processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day, leverage open - source technologies, and work on challenging and business-impacting projects. Responsibilities As a platform architect, you will be responsible for the availability and scalability of Qualys’s relational and NoSQL databases, search engines, graph databases, caches , big data systems and message pipelines. This at the s cale of a million transactions per second in NoSQL databases, across trillions of datapoints in the search engine, billions of messages per day flowing through the message pipelines and scaling 100s of terabytes of data in relational databases all with sub - second latencies . Responsible for driving the data source and providing data platform as a service to all applications built in Qualys. You will be part of the architecture review board reviewing application s’ architecture and identifying the data scale needs. Investigate the cutting - edge technologies , do POC, and then be responsible for defining the guidelines for using the data technologies at scale . Be the face and developer advocate of the stack you own and contribute back to open - source community if any enhancement is needed to fit in the Qualys ecosystem. Applying Machine Learning and AI technologies to improve the availability and performance of data platform services while keeping the operational costs down . Conduct brown bag sessions with application development teams to share guidelines, POC findings and industry trends. You will be instrumenting both day 1 and day 2 operations on these data technologies, keeping the 100s of thousands if not millions of operations per second. Migrate or burst into cloud and scale the stack with zero downtime. You will also be responsible for reviewing the cloud-native architecture of data platform technologies. You will be constantly in the hunt for better solutions out there to resolve the current issues with scal e , availability, and costs across cloud platforms. Co-develop with a strong sense of ownership, Qualys’ big-data platform that scales to meet/exceed the demands of processing over 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day. Architecture, performance, scalability, high availability, and security will be your primary goals for delivering a first-rate experience to our customers. Work closely with engineering teams, product management and operations to provide platform and infrastructure features and components to support Qualys’ business objectives . A day in the life… Apply advanced concepts, theories, and principles to create multi-disciplinary innovations and solutions for the most complex or risky data source related situations Contribute to the development of new data platform principles and concepts Collaborate with and suggest best practices to application teams in Qualys Provide thought leadership across multiple teams to ensure that systems and services are designed, and operating to achieve optimal levels of performance, reliability and sustainability interacting with data platform in Qualys Ensure security coding practices and security system fundamentals across multiple teams Demonstrate ability to identify important areas to instrument across multiple teams Who you are... A trendsetter. You thrive in an intellectually challenging environment with leading edge technologies. A teacher. You’re able to mentor your peers and help our team grow. A learner. You have an insatiable thirst for knowledge and greater understanding. A pragmatist. Your goal is to create useful products, not build technology for technology’s sake. An empath. We encourage open dialog and discourse. We don’t encourage silos. With agility. We don’t believe in following a process for the sake of the process . We invest in ourselves by applying our own strengths and interests to company needs. closest.title: Salesforce Developer
closest.text: Overview Quest Software is looking for a talented Salesforce Developer to join our Global IT team and help drive the evolution of our Salesforce ecosystem. In this role, you'll work on business-critical applications that support our global Go-To-Market organization, partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, and IT teams. You'll design and build scalable Salesforce solutions, develop integrations with enterprise platforms, and help shape the future of our commercial technology landscape. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex business challenges, working with modern Salesforce technologies, and making a direct impact on how a global software company operates. Responsibilities Design, develop, and enhance Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and declarative platform capabilities. Solve complex business challenges through a combination of configuration, custom development, and system integrations. Build scalable automation using Salesforce Flows and other platform tools. Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms using APIs and middleware technologies such as Boomi. Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams supporting Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to ensure end-to-end process alignment. Support Salesforce applications connected through managed packages and third-party GTM platforms. Follow development best practices, including code reviews, documentation, testing, and release management. Contribute to CI/CD processes using tools such as Copado and Azure DevOps. Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues while providing excellent support to internal users. Stay current with emerging Salesforce technologies, AI capabilities, and industry best practices. Qualifications Required Skills & Experience 4+ years of software development experience, including at least 2 years building and customizing solutions on the Salesforce Lightning Platform. Strong experience with: Apex Lightning Web Components (LWC) Lightning Experience Salesforce Flows Visualforce SOQL and Salesforce data management Experience integrating Salesforce with external applications through APIs and web services. Salesforce CPQ Service Cloud Experience Cloud Agentforce Slack for Salesforce Boomi integrations Eloqua Gainsight Gong Aviso Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Certifications Salesforce Platform Developer I Salesforce Platform App Builder Salesforce Lightning Experience Specialist Salesforce Lightning Component Framework Specialist In compliance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, the compensation for this role will start from €70,600 annually. Actual compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and performance. If eligible, commission or bonus is governed by a formal corporate plan. Benefit offering is based on a country-by-country basis Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization . More than 45,000 companies, including 90% of the Fortune 500, trust Quest to solve their most critical IT challenges. From securing identities and modernizing platforms to preparing data for AI, we help enterprises unlock their full potential. Why Quest At Quest, your work makes an impact. You’ll help organizations get AI-ready while building your career with a global team of innovators. We offer: Competitive pay, annual bonuses, and top-performer recognition. Comprehensive health, family, and retirement benefits. Flexible work options, generous PTO, and wellness programs. Professional growth through learning platforms, mentorship, and leadership programs. Inclusive teams that reflect the world we serve, supported by Employee Resource Groups and our Equality & Inclusion Council. Note: We do not use text messaging or third-party messaging apps like Telegram to communicate with applicants, so please exercise caution if you are approached in this way and only interact with people claiming to be Quest employees if they have an email address ending in @quest.com. #LI-AT1

nearMatches.text:
Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

  • The direct measurability of digital media.
  • Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
  • The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Software Engineer – Java (Quest v2 Platform Modernization)

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)
Experience: 3–6 Years

About the Role

We are looking for a Java Software Engineer to support the modernization of Quest, a high-volume event and workflow-processing platform that handles millions of events daily. You will work with senior engineers to develop, test, deploy, and support scalable backend services as part of the Quest v2 migration initiative.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Java/Spring Boot applications, REST APIs, and backend services.
  • Build event-driven solutions using Kafka and asynchronous processing patterns.
  • Develop and optimize database interactions using MySQL and SQL.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following engineering standards.
  • Create unit and integration tests and participate in code reviews.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, monitor application performance, and support deployments.
  • Contribute to platform modernization, reusable components, and technical documentation.

Required Skills

  • 3–6 years of software development experience with Java.
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, and backend service development.
  • Solid understanding of OOP, design patterns, multithreading, and concurrency.
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases (MySQL, Oracle, etc.).
  • Familiarity with JUnit, Mockito, Git, Maven/Gradle, and Linux environments.
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Kafka, event-driven architectures, and asynchronous processing.
  • Exposure to Redis, microservices, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience modernizing legacy Java applications.
  • Knowledge of application monitoring, logging, tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Experience working on high-volume transaction or workflow-processing systems.

 What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on engineer who takes ownership of features from development through production support.
  • Strong collaborator who follows established architecture patterns and coding standards.
  • Curious, accountable, and eager to learn in a complex, high-scale environment.

Note: This is an individual contributor role focused on software development and component ownership. It does not include architecture ownership, people management, or infrastructure administration.

QuinStreet is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, pregnancy status, sex, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristics protected by law.

Manual QA Engineer
Team Name: 360Finance
Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)
Experience: 4+ years
Employment Type: Full-Time

Key Responsibilities
•
Analyze business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications to develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
•
Perform functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, usability, and end-to-end testing of web-based applications.
•
Test RESTful APIs and validate request payloads, responses, status codes, error handling, and integrations with third-party systems.
•
Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution using appropriate defect-management tools.
•
Collaborate with developers, product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure high-quality releases.
•
Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
•
Prepare and maintain test plans, test cases, test data, regression suites, and test execution reports.
•
Validate application data using SQL queries and perform backend database testing.
•
Conduct production validation and support troubleshooting of issues reported by customers or internal teams.
•
Perform cross-browser and responsive testing across supported browsers and devices.
•
Identify gaps, edge cases, and potential risks early in the software development lifecycle.
•
Provide clear updates on testing progress, defects, release readiness, and quality risks.
•
Contribute to improving QA processes, testing standards, documentation, and overall product quality.

Required Skills and Qualifications
•
4+ years of professional experience in manual software testing or quality assurance.
•
Strong understanding of software testing concepts, methodologies, test levels, defect life cycles, and quality-assurance best practices.
•
Hands-on experience testing web applications and complex end-to-end business workflows.
•
Strong experience in functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and user-acceptance testing.
•
Experience testing RESTful APIs using tools such as Postman, Swagger, Insomnia, or similar tools.
•
Ability to write SQL queries for validating data in relational databases such as MariaDB, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
•
Experience creating detailed test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and execution reports.
•
Experience using defect and test-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, or similar platforms.
•
Good understanding of client-server architecture, HTTP/HTTPS, browser developer tools, JSON, and API-based integrations.
•
Experience working in Agile or Scrum development environments.
•
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
•
Ability to communicate defects, risks, and testing outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
•
Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned features, and manage testing priorities within release timelines.

Additional Skills — Good to Have
•
Experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or WebdriverIO.
•
Experience creating, maintaining, or executing automated regression test suites.
•
Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.
•
Experience with API automation tools or frameworks such as Rest Assured, Postman/Newman, or Karate.
•
Understanding of automation frameworks such as Page Object Model, data-driven testing, and behavior-driven development.
•
Familiarity with unit-testing frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or Pytest.
•
Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
•
Familiarity with Git and standard source-control workflows.
•
Basic knowledge of performance-testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6.
•
Familiarity with accessibility, security, or mobile application testing.
•
Experience testing financial-services, lending, payment, or other transaction-based applications.
